title: FlowReasoner: Reinforcing Query-Level Meta-Agents
authors: Hongcheng Gao; Yue Liu; Yufei He; Longxu Dou; Chao Du; Zhijie Deng; Bryan Hooi; Min Lin; Tianyu Pang
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing automated multi-agent-system (MAS) design methods search or optimize a single workflow at the task/domain level, so every query in a task is served by the same fixed system. The paper targets query-level MAS design: automatically producing one bespoke, personalized multi-agent workflow tailored to each individual user query rather than one system per task.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的自動化多智能體系統(MAS)設計方法在任務層級或領域層級搜尋或最佳化單一 workflow,因此同一任務中的每個 query 均由相同的固定系統處理。本文著眼於 query 層級的 MAS 設計:針對每一則使用者 query 自動產生一套量身訂製、個人化的多智能體 workflow,而非為每個任務提供單一系統。

key_innovation.en: A query-level meta-agent (FlowReasoner) that first acquires MAS-construction reasoning by distilling DeepSeek-R1, then is refined with reinforcement learning (GRPO) on external execution feedback under a multi-objective reward (pass-rate performance + AST complexity + workflow diversity/efficiency), so at inference it reasons deliberatively and generates a fresh multi-agent system per query.
key_innovation.zh: 本文提出一個 query 層級的 meta-agent(FlowReasoner):首先透過蒸餾 DeepSeek-R1 取得 MAS 建構的推理能力,再於外部執行回饋之上,以 RL(GRPO)在多目標獎勵(pass-rate 表現 + AST 複雜度 + workflow 多樣性/效率)下進一步精煉,使其在推論階段進行審慎推理,並為每一則 query 生成一套全新的多智能體系統。

baselines_compared: o1-mini, GPT-4o-mini, Self-Refine, LLM-Debate, LLM-Blender, AutoAgents, ADAS, Aflow, MaAS

key_improvements.en: 81.89% over 3 coding benchmarks: +5.08 vs MaAS, +10.52 vs vanilla o1-mini.
key_improvements.zh: 三個程式碼評測整體 81.89%:較 MaAS +5.08,較原生 o1-mini +10.52。

agent_scenario.en: One trained query-level meta-agent that, per user query, generates and then iteratively refines a bespoke multi-agent workflow. The generated workflow composes worker roles from a fixed six-operator set (Code Generator, Format Generator, Review, Revise, Ensemble, Code Test) executed by an underlying worker LLM (o1-mini in the main setting; also Qwen2.5-Coder-32B, Claude 3.5, GPT-4o-mini in generalization tests). Single domain: code generation. Protocol: deliberative reasoning to emit the MAS as Python code, followed by external-execution-feedback-driven iterative optimization with the iteration count fixed at 10.
agent_scenario.zh: 一個經訓練的 query 層級 meta-agent,針對每一則使用者 query 生成並隨後迭代精煉一套量身訂製的多智能體 workflow。所生成的 workflow 由固定的六個 operator 集合(Code Generator、Format Generator、Review、Revise、Ensemble、Code Test)組合出 worker 角色,並由底層 worker LLM 執行(主要設定為 o1-mini;泛化測試中另含 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B、Claude 3.5、GPT-4o-mini)。單一領域:程式碼生成。協定:以審慎推理將 MAS 產出為 Python 程式碼,隨後進行由外部執行回饋驅動的迭代最佳化,迭代次數固定為 10。
